name: print-social-banner-cyan-black-vr-diagonal-stripes
title: Cyan and black VR banner with diagonal stripe field
whatItIs: A wide banner split into a black text panel and a duotone-blue VR-headset photo panel, with a field of thick diagonal cyan/black stripes filling the photo side.
whatItMeans: A bold diagonal stripe field gives the photographic half as much graphic energy as the flat typographic half, so neither side of the split composition feels weaker.
techniques: split a banner into a flat type panel and a graphic-treated photo panel of near-equal visual weight
duotone a photo into the brand's two core colors to match the flat panel exactly
fill negative space with a bold diagonal stripe pattern instead of leaving it empty

vocabulary.definition: a layout divided into two or more distinct zones, often typographic vs. photographic
